_source: Puppet Master spike setup-desktop.sh (not a Rakazo file): the XFCE parts that were tested in the spike, minus the apps that base.json already provides (mousepad) and minus thunar (base uses pcmanfm, so the desktop has one file manager).
title: XFCE desktop
description: A full desktop with a panel, a settings app, notifications and a terminal. Heavier than the light desktop, but many people know it. Use it when a task needs settings windows or a familiar panel.
